changelog:
Initial release of CashClaw Data Scraper.

- Extracts structured data from websites and APIs with robust support for multiple formats (CSV, JSON).
- Handles pagination, deduplication, data cleaning, and enrichment to ensure reliable, high-quality datasets.
- Defines clear workflow steps: source identification, schema definition, extraction, cleaning, optional enrichment, and export.
- Tiered pricing model with guaranteed delivery times and scope per tier.
- Focus on business intelligence use cases, with ethical data collection guidance and thorough client requirements documentation.
- Includes practical examples and checklist to ensure data quality and delivery standards are met.
